'''Denhuir''' is a village located on the Maradon Road near the [[Black Hills]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Denhuir}}

Denhuir is the village where [[Mazrim Taim]] escapes the custody of [[Aes Sedai]]. When [[Siuan Sanche]] learns of this, she sends a dozen Aes Sedai and one thousand guards to capture and [[Severing#Gentling|gentle]] him.{{ref/book|4|17}}
